capabilities: Create an EOS/ workspace folder inside the current vault
Create and list user apps as Markdown files in EOS/apps/
Install starter project/task templates in EOS/templates/ without overwriting existing files
Store user content in the vault so plugin updates do not overwrite it
Open the workspace via a command-palette command
disambiguation: Not a manager for Obsidian's Workspaces (saved window layouts); it scaffolds an EOS/ folder of note files and templates inside the vault.
extras: Explicit MVP: legacy knowledge packs, Python scripts, account features, and Claudian-specific execution are excluded; platform support is untested and deferred to PLATFORM_SUPPORT.md.
problem: Obsidian provides no built-in way to bootstrap a structured workspace folder of reusable apps and templates that survives plugin updates.
summary: Workspace starter that scaffolds an EOS/ folder in the vault with user apps as Markdown files and starter project/task templates.
